$comment: ONE TREE. Everything that changes how the system runs is declared here. A group marked shown becomes a section in the sidebar. Types are pyqtgraph's and JSON Schema's: group, bool, int, float, str, list, action, status. Why one tree is [[one-tree-holds-every-parameter]].
name: quackitect

children.name: shown
children.help: Which groups appear in the sidebar. The gear chooses them.

children.name: log
children.label: lines
children.title: show log / open the log window in a terminal

children.name: home
children.label: home
children.title: home / the engine's own home page, not the project it drives

children.name: init
children.label: plus
children.title: init / make this folder a project, or a vehicle that carries the method

titles.off: finish up / no new work goes out and none is taken up, while the agent finishes what it holds and works its notes. Press five times to stop everything
titles.finishing: finishing up / the agent takes nothing new and works the notes it holds, then stops. Press to let it go on
titles.held: held / everything is on hold. Press to let it go on

titles.off: ask / the agent says what it and every subagent is working on. Nothing else runs until it does
titles.on: asked / waiting for the agent to say what is happening. It untoggles when the answer lands

titles.off: ideation / let the agent put its own ideas in, rather than only working the tokens it is handed
titles.on: ideation / the agent may put its own ideas in. Press to have it work only what it is handed

titles.bound: unbind / take the queue off: no token on a write, no token on a command, nobody made to spawn. Press five times for god mode
titles.unbound: unbound / the queue is off. Press to put it back
titles.god: GOD MODE / every refusal this engine has is off. Press to put it all back

children.name: agents
children.help: Who is working, and on what.

children.name: editor
children.label: hammer
children.title: work / open the work editor. Press it again to close it

children.name: mint
children.title: This writes a note. Four words name it. After the slash goes everything the next hand needs. Enter mints it.

children.name: parallel_agents
children.title: parallel agents
children.help: How many workers there are, counting the main agent, and how many reviewers beside them. At three the main agent spawns two workers and three reviewers. More finishes more at a time and costs more. Zero means the main agent works alone.

children.name: claim_hours
children.title: a claim lasts
children.help: How long one machine keeps work reserved before another may take it. Short frees work quickly when a machine never comes back. Long stops two machines racing for it.

children.name: claim_sync_seconds
children.title: look for claims every
children.help: How often this machine looks for work another machine has reserved. Lower notices sooner. Zero stops looking, and then two machines can start the same thing.

children.name: heartbeat_seconds
children.title: heartbeat
children.help: How often the engine says it is alive. Lower spots a dead one sooner and writes more to the log.

children.name: ready_budget_ms
children.title: ready in
children.help: How long the agent has to start after you press. Raise it on a slow machine, where the light goes red for nothing.

children.name: helper_ratio
children.title: helper hands back
children.help: How much a helper may hand back: one part in this many of what it read. A helper that returns what it read has saved you nothing. Higher asks for a shorter answer.

children.name: helper_floor_bytes
children.title: helper may always hand back
children.help: How much a helper may always hand back, however little it read. Without it, a helper given a small job has almost no room to answer at all.

children.name: pulls_before_hold_is_stale
children.title: work goes stale after
children.help: How long work may sit with an agent that has gone quiet before somebody else may take it. It is counted in how often the others ask for work, not in minutes, so a busy team notices sooner. Too low and a slow worker is interrupted.

children.name: answer_first
children.title: answer them first
children.help: Stop the agent until it has answered you. Without this it works on through your question.

children.name: guard_projections
children.title: projections
children.help: Stop the agent editing a file that is written from somewhere else. The edit would be thrown away the next time that file is written.

children.name: stop_needs_claim
children.title: stop needs a claim
children.help: Make the agent say why it is stopping. Without this a turn ends with no reason in the record.

children.name: search_via_index
children.title: search via index
children.help: Make the agent search through the engine rather than the disk. Every line of the tree is in there, and it answers faster.

children.name: tests_via_engine
children.title: tests via engine
children.help: Make the agent test through the engine, which runs the tests its own change reaches. By hand it runs everything, or the wrong thing.

children.name: build_via_engine
children.title: build via engine
children.help: Make the agent ask the engine to rebuild itself. A build by hand leaves the program that is running and the one on disk as two different builds.
